name: J850 Prime
summary: Multi-material, full-colour PolyJet for realistic prototypes and design models.

page.description: Stratasys J850 Prime 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Dream it.
page.lead: Full-colour, multi-material prototypes in one print: up to seven resins, 14-micron layers and PANTONE-validated colour, from glass-like clear to rubber-like flexible.
page.footnote: † Stratasys claim (the same page also states 600,000+). Source: stratasys.com J850 Prime page, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: PANTONE-validated colour
features.text: Colour matching that design and marketing teams can approve.

features.title: Up to seven resins
features.text: Rigid, flexible, clear and tough in one model.

features.title: Four print modes
features.text: From 14 µm High Quality to 55 µm Super High Speed drafts.

features.title: FabriX Innovation Kit
features.text: Print onto fabric and flexible substrates.

benefits.title: Faster models
benefits.text: Full-colour models in 20 % of the time of traditional methods (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Lower cost
benefits.text: Prototyping cost cut by more than 80 % (Stratasys claim).

benefits.title: Fewer iterations
benefits.text: Validate designs up to 5× faster (Stratasys claim).

specs.label: Print modes
specs.value: High Quality: up to 7 resins, 14 µm · High Mix: up to 7 resins, 27 µm · High Speed: up to 3 resins, 27 µm · Super High Speed: 1 resin, 55 µm

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: Under 100 mm: ±100 µm. Over 100 mm: ±200 µm or ±0.06 % of part length, whichever is greater (typical, rigid materials)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: ToughONE, VeroVivid, VeroUltra Clear, Agilus30, VeroUltra, Digital ABS Plus, DraftGrey

page.applications_heading: Prototypes your stakeholders can sign off.
